meta.title: 8Router — One Endpoint for Every AI Provider
meta.description: 8Router unifies 12+ AI providers into one OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Auto-routing, fallback, quota tracking, and circuit breaker.
meta.ogTitle: 8Router — One Endpoint for Every AI Provider
meta.ogDescription: Auto-routing for 12 AI providers. One endpoint, smart fallback.

hero.title1: One endpoint for the AI providers you already use.
hero.sub: Run 8Router on your own infrastructure, connect your provider keys, and keep compatible tools moving when one route becomes unavailable.
services.title: Built for messy real-world AI workflows.

aliases.desc: Use simple aliases instead of memorizing provider-specific model names.

alias.smartDesc: Routes to the strongest available model for reasoning-heavy tasks.
alias.codingDesc: Optimized for coding, debugging, tool use, and long context tasks.

how.title: How It Works
how.desc: Install once, connect your providers, and reduce rate-limit interruptions with health-aware fallback.

features.title: Routing you can inspect
features.desc: Health checks, fallback decisions, and request history stay visible in the dashboard.
feat.adaptersDesc: 12 providers with dedicated adapters for request normalization, response parsing, and health checks.
feat.capabilityDesc: 30+ models tracked for vision, tools, streaming, embeddings, context length, and cost.
feat.smartPickerDesc: Score-based model selection using cost, speed, quality, and latency data.
feat.costTableDesc: Per-model pricing with input/output token costs, currency, and free quota tracking.
feat.latencyDesc: p50/p95/p99 latency tracking per provider with automatic health monitoring.
feat.circuitDesc: Automatic provider cooldown after 5 consecutive failures. 3-minute reset window.
feat.keyPoolDesc: Track key status: healthy, rate_limited, exhausted, invalid, cooldown. Auto-skip bad keys.
feat.quotaTrackerDesc: Per-provider quota tracking across 5h, daily, weekly, and monthly periods.
feat.secretsDesc: API keys masked in all responses, logs, dashboard, and error messages.
feat.sanitizationDesc: Error messages sanitized to remove sensitive data before logging or returning.
feat.setupGuideDesc: Ready-to-copy configs for Cursor, Cline, Continue, OpenWebUI, Claude Code, and Codex.

db.page.canonicalDesc: Controlled canonical runtime experiment — shadow comparison and canary testing
db.canonical.shadowInfo: Shadow mode never changes user responses. It compares canonical and legacy transformations in parallel and logs structural mismatches.
db.canonical.canaryInfo: Canary mode routes a limited percentage of eligible requests through the canonical runtime and automatically falls back to the legacy path on failures.
db.canonical.offInfo: Canonical runtime is disabled. Production traffic uses the current stable runtime path only.
db.canonical.canaryWarn: Canary mode is experimental. Start at 1% or lower and monitor mismatch and failure rates.

db.toksv.title: Token Saver
db.toksv.desc: Compresses repetitive machine-generated tool output (terminal logs, test results, stack traces, build output) before forwarding to AI providers. Never compresses system prompts, user messages, tool-call arguments, or structured JSON.
db.toksv.modeSafe: Safe — Remove duplicate lines & progress noise
db.toksv.modeBalanced: Balanced — Safe + condense test output, stacks, trees, diffs
db.toksv.modeAggressive: Aggressive — Stronger heuristics, may omit more non-critical output
db.toksv.modeOffDesc: Compression is disabled. All content passes through unchanged.
db.toksv.modeSafeDesc: Removes exact duplicate lines, collapses repeated warnings with counts, and trims progress noise. Preserves all unique errors, commands, paths, and summaries.
db.toksv.modeBalancedDesc: Includes Safe mode plus condenses passing test lists, repeated stack frames, deep directory trees, grep results, and git diffs while preserving critical content.
db.toksv.modeAggressiveDesc: Includes Balanced mode with stronger heuristic condensation. Retains critical errors, warnings, failed tests, changed files, and summaries. Unsupported or uncertain content is left unchanged.
db.toksv.safetyNote: System, developer, and user messages are never compressed. Tool-call arguments, schemas, structured JSON, and source code are never touched. Unknown content fails open to the original.
